title: Inventory: Breunig et al. 2014 (PLOS Genetics 10:e1004142) supporting information
intro: Generated by `ingest/inventory.py` from `sources/breunig2014/raw/`: the eight supporting-information files of
and saved as `journal.pgen.1004142.s00N.<ext>`, extension from the file type (PLOS sends no file names).
Figures S1-S5 are EPS files although the captions call them TIFF. The article page is kept as `sources/breunig2014/article.html`.

roles.journal.pgen.1004142.s001.eps: Figure S1: accumulation of metabolic genes in randomly permuted confidence intervals (figure only).
roles.journal.pgen.1004142.s002.eps: Figure S2: 95% Bayes credible intervals (R/qtl bayesint) of chromosome V-linked metabolites (figure only; bounds not tabulated).
roles.journal.pgen.1004142.s003.eps: Figure S3: 95% credible intervals of chromosome VIII-linked metabolites (figure only).
roles.journal.pgen.1004142.s004.eps: Figure S4: 95% credible intervals of chromosome XV-linked metabolites (figure only).
roles.journal.pgen.1004142.s005.eps: Figure S5: metabolite levels by IRA2 allele in allele-replacement strains (figure only).
roles.journal.pgen.1004142.s006.pdf: Table S1: all metabolite linkages with LOD, closest marker chromosome and genetic position (cM), and parental p-value. Core input.
roles.journal.pgen.1004142.s007.pdf: Table S2: pathway and metabolic genes in each compound's confidence interval(s). Kept verbatim (page text), not drawn.
roles.journal.pgen.1004142.s008.xlsx: Table S3: carbon-cycle genes with eQTLs containing IRA2 (from Smith et al.). Kept verbatim, not drawn.

missing: No physical (bp) position for any linkage: Table S1 gives the closest marker's chromosome and genetic position in cM only, and the 2,820-marker map is not in the bundle. See OPEN_QUESTIONS.md.
No table of confidence-interval bounds: the 95% Bayes credible intervals appear only in Figures S2-S4 (images).
No effect sizes per linkage; allele direction is stated in the text for a few linkages only.
No segregant genotypes or metabolite levels; the 74 compounds tested without linkage are named nowhere in a table.
